      • getFirst

        public static <T extends SelectableRecord> T getFirst(DbContext context,
                                                      Selection<T> selection,
                                                      FieldSet<? super T> fieldSet)
        Returns the first object specified by selection using the given fieldSet.
        This implies setting LazyLoad to false.
        Type Parameters:
        T - The type to select
        Parameters:
        context - The database context
        selection - A selection that can have a not known number of result objects
        fieldSet - Specifies the fields to load. See RecordLoader.setFields(FieldSet) for details.
        Returns:
        The first object found specified by selection or null if found none.

      • getFirst

        public static <T extends SelectableRecord> T getFirst(DbContext context,
                                                      Selection<T> selection,
                                                      boolean lazyLoad,
                                                      String... fields)
        Returns the first object specified by selection using the given fields.
        Lazy loading of field values is set to lazyLoad.
        Type Parameters:
        T - The type to select
        Parameters:
        context - The database context
        selection - A selection that can have a not known number of result objects
        lazyLoad - Enable or disable lazy loading of field values. See RecordLoader.setLazyLoad(boolean).
        fields - Defines the fields to load into a client context query. See RecordLoader.setFields(FieldSet).
        Returns:
        The first object found specified by selection or null if found none.

      • getFirst

        public static <T extends SelectableRecord> T getFirst(DbContext context,
                                                      Selection<T> selection,
                                                      boolean lazyLoad,
                                                      FieldSet<T> fields)
        Returns the first object specified by selection using the given fields.
        Lazy loading of field values is set to lazyLoad.
        Type Parameters:
        T - The type to select
        Parameters:
        context - The database context
        selection - A selection that can have a not known number of result objects
        lazyLoad - Enable or disable lazy loading of field values. See RecordLoader.setLazyLoad(boolean).
        fields - Defines the fields to load into a client context query. See RecordLoader.setFields(FieldSet).
        Returns:
        The first object found specified by selection or null if found none.
